remarks: Welcome to "The Motif at Glendora Place, " an immaculate, tri-level townhouse nestled in the highly desirable city of Glendora. Built in 2017, this exceptional end unit shares only one wall, offering unparalleled privacy, soaring high ceilings, and an abundance of natural sunlight throughout its open and airy layout. As the largest floor plan in the community, this home features 1,860 sq. ft. of living space with 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a private junior master suite with a full bath on the first level—perfect for guests or a home office.
